source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 559 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text:
ARTICLE 559.

PD 559.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-559.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 559 was established by Ordinance No. 24134, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 8, 1999. Ordinance No. 24134 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 24134; 25163)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-559.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 559 is established on property fronting on the south side of Westgrove Drive, east of Angleview Drive. The size of PD 559 is approximately 9.1850 acres. (Ord. Nos. 24134; 25163)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-559.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all code references are to Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 24134; 25163)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-559.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of Tracts 1 and 1A of the Property must comply with the development plan for Tracts 1 and 1A (Exhibit 559A). Development and use of Tract 2 of the Property must comply with the development plan for Tract 2 (Exhibit 559A-1). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development plan, the provisions of this article control. (Ord. Nos. 24134; 25163; 25934; 27095)

sections.title: Construction Traffic
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-559.105. CONSTRUCTION TRAFFIC.

It is the intent of the city council to minimize construction traffic in residential neighborhoods. Therefore, issuance of any building permit on the Property is conditioned upon approval of a construction traffic management plan by the building official showing that the proposed routes for construction traffic will not go through minor residential streets. A violation of the construction management plan is a violation of this article and may result in issuance of citations or a stop-work order. (Ord. Nos. 24134; 25163)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-559.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Institutional and community service uses.

-- Church.

(b) Miscellaneous uses.

-- Temporary construction or sales office.

(c) Residential uses.

-- Handicapped group dwelling unit. [SUP required if spacing component of Section 51A-4.209(3.1) is not met.] -- Single family.

(d) Transportation uses.

-- Private street or alley.

(e) Utility and public service uses.

-- Local utilities. (Ord. Nos. 24134; 25163)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-559.107. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations contained in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted in this district:

-- Accessory helistop. -- Accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator. -- Accessory outside display of merchandise. -- Accessory outside sales. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator. -- Private stable. (Ord. Nos. 24134; 25163)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-559.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(a) Front yard for Tracts 1, 1A, and 2.

(1) Minimum front yard setback for Tracts 1 and 1A is as shown on the development plan for Tracts 1 and 1A.

(2) Minimum front yard setback for Tract 2 is 20 feet, except that for Lot 3, the footprint of a residential structure must be within the footprint shown on the development plan for Tract 2.

(b) Side and rear yard.

(1) Tracts 1 and 1A. Minimum side yard is five feet, and minimum rear yard is 15 feet.

(2) Tract 2. Minimum side and rear yard setback is six feet, except that for Lot 3, the footprint of a residential structure must be within the footprint shown on the development plan for Tract 2.

(c) Density.

(1) Tracts 1 and 1A. Maximum total number of dwelling units is six.

(2) Tract 2. Maximum number of dwelling units is five.

(d) Height for Tracts 1, 1A, and 2. Maximum structure height is 36 feet.

(e) Lot coverage for Tracts 1, 1A, and 2. Maximum lot coverage is 40 percent for residential structures and 25 percent for nonresidential structures.

(f) Lot size.

(1) Tracts 1 and 1A. Minimum lot size for residential uses is one-half acre.

(2) Tract 2. Minimum lot size for residential uses is one-half acre. (Ord. Nos. 24134; 25163; 25934; 27095)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-559.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

For all permitted uses, consult the use regulations contained in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. Consult Division 51A-4.300 for information regarding off-street parking and loading generally. (Ord. Nos. 24134; 25163)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-559.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 24134; 25163)

sections.title: Electrical Service For Single Family Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-559.111. ELECTRICAL SERVICE FOR SINGLE FAMILY USES.

(a) In this planned development district, a lot for a single family use may be supplied by not more than one electrical utility service, and metered by not more than one electrical meter.

(b) The board of adjustment may grant a special exception to authorize more than one electrical utility service and more than one electrical meter on a lot in this planned development district when, in the opinion of the board, the special exception will:

(1) not be contrary to the public interest;

(2) not adversely affect neighboring properties; and

(3) not be used to conduct a use not permitted in this planned development district. (Ord. Nos. 24134; 25163)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-559.112. ACCESS.

Ingress and egress must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 24134; 25163)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-559.113. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Prior to the final inspection for each single family use, landscaping for each platted lot must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) Prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for all other permitted uses, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(c) All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 24134; 25163)

sections.title: Tree Preservation
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-559.114. TREE PRESERVATION.

(a) Except as provided in Subsections (b) and (c) below, the regulations contained in Division 51A-10.130, "Tree Preservation," apply to this planned development district.

(b) Prior to the removal of any trees from the Property, a tree survey must be completed and delivered to the building official.

(c) Tree removal applications may be approved by the building official prior to the issuance of a building permit on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 24134; 25163)

sections.title: Fences, Walls, Entryway Columns, And Gates
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-559.115. FENCES, WALLS, ENTRYWAY COLUMNS, AND GATES.

(a) Except as provided in Subsections (c) and (d), the maximum height for all fences, walls, entryway columns, and gates on the Property, excluding those that front on a public or private street or an access easement, is 10 feet.

(b) Except as provided in Subsections (c) and (d), the maximum height for all fences and walls on the Property that front a public or private street or an access easement is 12 feet. The maximum height for all entryway columns and gates on the Property that front on a public or private street or an access easement is 18 feet.

(c) On Tract 1, fences located in the required front yard may not exceed four feet in height. If property on Tract 2 is replatted, fences on Tract 2 located in the required front yard may not exceed four feet in height.

(d) On Tract 1A, fences located in the required front yard as shown on the Tract 1A fence detail plan (Exhibit 559B):

(1) may not exceed seven feet in height;

(2) must be constructed of brick, stone, concrete masonry, wrought iron, or similar materials, or a combination of these materials, but not wood or chain link; and

(3) to allow for visibility, must be 90 percent open.

(e) The visual obstruction regulations contained in Section 51A-4.602(d) apply to this planned development district. (Ord. Nos. 24134; 25163; 25934; 27095)

sections.title: Floodway
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-559.116. FLOODWAY.

(a) No platted lot may extend into the floodway.

(b) Any land area extending into the floodway must be dedicated as a floodway management area, floodway easement, common area, or park. (Ord. Nos. 24134; 25163)

sections.title: Homeowners’ Association
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-559.117. HOMEOWNERS’ ASSOCIATION.

Prior to final plat approval, the owner(s) of the Property within Tract 1, Tract 1A, and Tract 2 must execute an instrument creating a homeowners' association for the maintenance of common areas, screening walls, landscape areas (including right-of-way landscaping areas), private streets, and for other functions. This instrument must be approved as to form by the city attorney, and filed in the Dallas County deed records. (Ord. Nos. 24134; 25163; 25934; 27095)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-559.118. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 24134; 25163)

sections.title: Sidewalks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-559.119. SIDEWALKS.

(a) Sidewalks and barrier free ramps are required along the Westgrove Drive street frontage.

(b) Sidewalks and barrier free ramps are not required for all other street frontage on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 24134; 25163)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-559.120. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24134; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-559.121. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this planned development district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas

Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24134; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-559.122. ZONING MAP.

PD 559 is located on Zoning Map No. A-7. (Ord. Nos. 24134; 25163)
